title: Send JSON data
summary: Laravel: Send JSON data. Add an author field.
introduction: The response helper can make JSON. Open GET /book. Read the example, then check the result.

blocks.text: Create a practice Laravel project with Composer, then replace routes/web.php with one example. Start php artisan serve --host=127.0.0.1 --port=8000. These read-only starter routes need no database.

blocks.title: Send JSON data
blocks.code:
<?php
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
Route::get("/book", fn () => response()->json(["title" => "Moon Trip", "pages" => 24]));

blocks.text: The response helper serialises the PHP array as a JSON object.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use a JSON response when sending data rather than HTML.
